caption:
i overruled my plan on purpose. it took notes

#gym #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
The day I disagreed with it
and trained anyway

It said easy day

I didn't feel like easy

So I lifted

It didn't argue
It adjusted

The next two days
quietly got lighter

My choice went into the math

A coach you can overrule
is a coach you can trust

slides.heading: It bends, you decide
slides.body: SOMA recommends, you choose — and tomorrow's plan starts from what you actually did, not what it wished you did
